description:
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs DeviationScope::matches IssuerDnContains arm (lines 317-319):

    let mut issuer_lower = cert.tbs_certificate.issuer.to_string();
    issuer_lower.make_ascii_lowercase();
    issuer_lower.contains(substring.as_str())

cert.tbs_certificate.issuer.to_string() allocates a new String on every call to matches(). For a chain evaluation with N certs and D deviations active, this is N * D allocations of the same issuer DN string.

The standard Rust idiom for repeated-comparisons-with-one-side-invariant is to pre-compute and cache the issuer string. Since DeviationScope::matches takes &Certificate (not a pre-formatted string), the allocation happens inside the loop.

Fix options:
1. Add a DeviationScope::matches_with_issuer_str(&self, issuer_lower: &str) variant that accepts a pre-lowercased issuer string, so the caller can compute it once per cert and reuse across multiple DeviationScope checks.
2. Change find_deviation to accept a pre-formatted issuer string alongside the cert.

Either option eliminates the repeated to_string() allocation in the common IssuerDnContains path.

Category: R5 (String allocation in hot path where &str would suffice)
title: rusty: IssuerDnContains matching allocates String on every call via to_string()
